##### Project general facts

Breig Oasis IV is a boutique complex of smart townhouses that continues the developer's Oasis line. The townhouses are designed as modern smart homes with light, airy living rooms, high ceilings, floor-to-ceiling glazing and open-plan layouts.

Each townhouse has its own private pool and garden courtyard and a dedicated parking space at the entrance. The territory is guarded around the clock, and the developer provides warranties on general defects, load-bearing structures, waterproofing and anti-termite treatment. Owners can live in the townhouse or hand it to the BREIG management company, which prepares it for rental, lists it on booking platforms, manages guests and sends monthly income reports.

The townhouses are delivered fully furnished, with a fully equipped kitchen with premium appliances, spacious bedrooms with a work area and extra-king-size beds, and a choice of interior finishing options.

##### Parking

Private parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Canggu is one of the most popular coastal areas on the southwest coast of Bali, known for its surf beaches, rice field landscapes and relaxed creative atmosphere. Batu Bolong, Echo and Berawa beaches line its coast.

The area offers a dense choice of cafes, restaurants, beach clubs, coworking spaces, gyms and yoga studios, along with international schools and clinics. Seminyak and the other main hubs of the south are within easy driving distance.

Strong demand from surfers, remote workers and long-stay travellers makes Canggu one of the leading villa rental markets on the island, with well-designed homes near the beach in particular demand.
